description: JavaScript source file for SuiteCRM Schedulers module, including functions for form validation, cron interval validation, UI toggling, and scheduler initialization.

methods.name: checkFormPre
methods.description: Validates form and toggles advanced options if errors are found.

methods.name: validateCronInterval
methods.description: Validates cron interval fields in the form.

methods.name: toggleAdv
methods.description: Toggles between simple and advanced scheduler UI views.

methods.name: allDays
methods.description: Selects or deselects all days of the week checkboxes.

methods.name: updateVisibility
methods.description: Updates visibility of scheduler options based on checkbox state.

methods.name: initScheduler
methods.description: Initializes scheduler UI based on the adv_interval variable.
